# Documentation Instructions

Use these rules for documentation changes.

- Keep documentation short, practical, and specific to Timew Tray.
- Document setup requirements: .NET SDK, Avalonia workload/package expectations, and Timewarrior installation.
- Include platform notes for Linux, macOS, and Windows when behavior differs.
- Do not document unrelated server, storage, AI, automation, or web-app concepts.
- Prefer command examples that work from the repository root.
- Update screenshots or manual test notes when UI behavior changes.
